messages:
deploy-bot: Partial promote failed: notifications-service chart=notify-chart image.tag=v5.0.0 in ap-southeast-1. Canary at 5% reported readiness probes flapping and a crash in postinstall hook. Promotion paused. Asking eng-releases for rollback vs hotpatch direction.

ana: Looking into postinstall hook logs now. This was a new chart hook we added to run schema-checks.

kevin: We're inside the change window but there's also a downstream dependency update on the auth-service in eu-west-1 that landed earlier. Might be related.

sre-oncall: If hooks are failing only in ap-southeast it could be resource class mismatch. My bias: rollback regional canary to v4.9.3 and pin until we validate hooks in a dev cluster.

ana: Confirmed error: hook job OOMKilled, container tried to allocate 1.2Gi but node allocable memory on the canary nodes is 1Gi. Chart overlay bumped `hook.resources.requests.memory=1200Mi` in v5.0.0 — that explains it.

release-manager: Given cross-region dependencies and change window, I propose: rollback canary in ap-southeast, pin v4.9.3, open hotfix patch that reduces hook memory and adds a `hook.enabled` toggle so we can gate in staging first. Also update release notes and target next canary in eu-west with adjusted values.

kevin: Agree. Minimal risk route is rollback + pin. We can test hook.enabled=false in a dev overlay before re-promote.

ana: Rollback command I'm about to run for the regional subset:
```
helm upgrade notify-prod notify-chart --namespace prod-ap-southeast \
  --set image.tag=v4.9.3 \
  --set canary.traffic=0.05 \
  --reuse-values
```
I'm also setting `release-lock:notifications-service@v4.9.3` in deploy tool.

deploy-bot: Lock created: `notifications-service@v4.9.3` (reason: regional hook memory OOM on v5.0.0). Staged promotes blocked. Link: https://deploy/locks/98765

kevin: Quick check on customer impact? Any dropped notifications?

sre-oncall: Alerting shows ~0.8% increase in retry events for the canary cohort, mostly recovered on retry. No user-facing outage detected.

release-manager: I'll draft a brief release note: "Rollback regional canary for notifications-service due to hook job OOM on small canary nodes. Pinned v4.9.3 pending hotfix that adds hook.enabled flag and lowers memory request." Will also add runbook to verify hook in dev/staging.

ana: Opening PR with chart patch: https://git/repo/pulls/789 — changes: add `hook.enabled` (default true), lower default hook memory to `512Mi`, add note in chart README about node class requirements. Includes smoke test steps.

kevin: After patch merged, let's promote to a single cross-region canary at 0.5% with hook.enabled=false then run the hook-enabled canary in a bigger nodepool. Keep deploy lock until we validate.

deploy-bot: Event log: rollback-executed, lock-created, alert-generated. No automated promote until lock cleared.

sre-oncall: Monitoring shows canary cohort in ap-southeast stable post-rollback. I'll run a 20m watch and then signal for unlock if no regressions.

release-manager: Scheduling 15m sync x-post-rollback to confirm notes and unlock criteria. Also will coordinate customer comms if required.

ana: thumbs up. I'll add the checklist for smoke tests to the PR and add QA steps for the regional nodepool size.

deploy-bot: Thread will be closed when stability is confirmed and lock removed.
